units.source_text: 驹子焦急地站起来，冷不防地搂住岛村的脖子，她简直方寸已乱，

en.t: Komako sprang up in agitation and, without warning, threw her arms around Shimamura's neck, completely beside herself,

units.source_text: 顺嘴说了一句：“你不该说这种话呀。

en.t: and blurted out, "You must not say things like that.
Get up. I am telling you to get up."

units.source_text: 说着她自己却躺了下来，狂热得不能自己了。

en.t: As she said it, she herself lay down, carried away by a frenzy she could no longer control.

units.source_text: 过了片刻，她睁开了温柔而湿润的眼睛：“真的，你明天就回去吧。”

en.t: After a while, she opened her gentle, moist eyes and said, "Truly, you should go back tomorrow."

units.source_text: 她平静地说过之后，捡起了脱落的发丝。

en.t: After saying this calmly, she picked up the strands of hair that had fallen loose.

units.source_text: 岛村决定第二天下午三点动身。

en.t: Shimamura decided to leave at three o'clock the next afternoon.

units.source_text: 正在换装的时候，客栈掌柜悄悄地把驹子叫到走廊上。

en.t: While he was changing clothes, the innkeeper quietly called Komako out into the corridor.

units.source_text: 岛村听到驹子回答说：“是啊，你就算十一个钟头好了。”

en.t: Shimamura heard Komako answer, "Yes, just count it as eleven hours."

units.source_text: 大概是掌柜认为算十六七个小时太长了。

en.t: The innkeeper had probably thought that counting sixteen or seventeen hours was too long.
